# MovieSphere App - 3 Features Implementation Complete ✅
## Summary All three requested features have been successfully implemented in the MovieSphere Android app:
---
## FEATURE 1: ⭐ Star Icon Favorite Button ✅
### Implementation Details: - **File Modified**: `MovieDetailsActivity.java` - **Layout File Modified**: `activity_movie_details.xml` - **Drawable Files Created**: - `ic_star_empty.xml` - Empty/outline star (yellow tint) - `ic_star_filled.xml` - Filled yellow star
### Changes Made: 1. **Button Type Change**: - Changed `favouriteButton` from `Button` to `ImageButton` - Updated in both Java code and XML layout
2. **XML Layout Update**: - Replaced text button with `ImageButton` - Set source to `ic_star_empty` by default - Added yellow tint (#FFD700) - Kept `rounded_button_outline` background style
3. **Java Logic Update**: - `updateFavouriteButton()` method now uses: - `setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_star_filled)` when favorited - `setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_star_empty)` when not favorited - Star color is yellow (#FFD700) when filled - Background remains consistent with current style
4. **Functionality Preserved**: - Database logic remains unchanged - Toggle functionality works perfectly - Toast messages display appropriately - Star state persists on activity reload
---
## FEATURE 2: Glide Library for Image Loading ✅
### Implementation Details: - **Files Modified**: - `build.gradle` - Added Glide annotation processor - `MovieAdapter.java` - Enhanced Glide implementation - `MovieDetailsActivity.java` - Enhanced Glide implementation
### Changes Made:
#### A) build.gradle Dependencies: ```gradle implementation 'com.github.bumptech.glide:glide:4.16.0' annotationProcessor 'com.github.bumptech.glide:compiler:4.16.0' ```
#### B) AndroidManifest.xml: ✅ Internet permission already present: ```xml <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/> ```
#### C) Glide Configuration Applied: **Pattern used in both activities**: ```java Glide.with(context) .load(posterUrl) .centerCrop() .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_movie_placeholder) .error(R.drawable.ic_movie_placeholder) .diskCacheStrategy(DiskCacheStrategy.ALL) .into(imageView); ```
**Features enabled**: - ✅ `centerCrop()` - Scales images to fill the ImageView - ✅ `placeholder()` - Shows gray placeholder while loading - ✅ `error()` - Shows placeholder if image fails to load - ✅ `diskCacheStrategy(ALL)` - Enables caching for performance - ✅ Custom placeholder drawable: `ic_movie_placeholder.xml`
#### D) Placeholder Drawable: Created `ic_movie_placeholder.xml` with: - Gray background (#415A77) - Movie frame icon design - Readable at different sizes
#### E) Applied to All Activities: - ✅ `MovieAdapter.java` - ListView items (100x150dp with override) - ✅ `MovieDetailsActivity.java` - Movie poster display - ✅ `HistoryActivity.java` - Uses same adapter - ✅ `MyFavouritesActivity.java` - Uses same adapter
---

### Implementation Details: - **Files Modified**: - `colors.xml` - Added complete color palette - `themes.xml` - Created custom MovieSphere theme - `values-night/themes.xml` - Dark theme compatibility - `AndroidManifest.xml` - Applied theme globally

<!-- Secondary colors --> <item name="colorSecondary">@color/colorYellow</item> <item name="colorSecondaryVariant">@color/colorYellow</item> <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/colorPrimaryDark</item>
<!-- Status and Navigation bars --> <item name="android:statusBarColor">@color/colorPrimaryDark</item> <item name="android:navigationBarColor">@color/colorPrimary</item>
<!-- Text and Background --> <item name="android:textColorPrimary">@color/colorTextPrimary</item> <item name="android:textColorSecondary">@color/colorTextSecondary</item> <item name="android:windowBackground">@color/colorBackground</item> </style> ```
### Global Application: ```xml <application android:theme="@style/Theme.MovieSphere" ... > ```
### Theme Benefits: - ✅ Cohesive dark theme across entire app - ✅ Material Design 3 compatibility - ✅ Yellow accent for star/highlight elements - ✅ Day/Night support via DayNight parent theme - ✅ Professional appearance with high contrast text
---
## Files Changed Summary
### Java Files: - ✅ `MovieDetailsActivity.java` - Star button logic + Enhanced Glide - ✅ `MovieAdapter.java` - Enhanced Glide implementation
### Layout Files: - ✅ `activity_movie_details.xml` - Star icon button UI
### Resource Files: - ✅ `build.gradle` - Glide annotation processor - ✅ `AndroidManifest.xml` - Theme application - ✅ `colors.xml` - Theme color definitions - ✅ `themes.xml` - Theme style definition - ✅ `values-night/themes.xml` - Night mode theme
### Drawable Files Created: - ✅ `ic_star_empty.xml` - Empty star icon - ✅ `ic_star_filled.xml` - Filled star icon - ✅ `ic_movie_placeholder.xml` - Movie placeholder
